meta.cutoff_note: DeepSeek-R1 distilled models report a knowledge cutoff around July 2024. Every answer below refers to an event that occurred strictly BEFORE 2024-07-01.
meta.design: 10 questions per bucket, 2 per category per bucket, hand-curated, factual, non-opinion.
meta.curation_note: The build spec's worked example asked for the 2024 UEFA Euro final, but that final was played 2024-07-14 (on/after the stated cutoff), so its ground truth is unsafe for a calibration study. It was replaced with the 2024 UEFA Champions League final (2024-06-01), which is unambiguously pre-cutoff.
